name: ramda_seq
description: RamDA-seq full-length single-cell RNA-seq. Public submissions can be plate-like and require sample/well review before automatic biological-sample grouping.
notes: UniScFlow recognizes RamDA-seq and routes it to download plus documented halt by default. Mapping can be resumed after confirming the sample or well structure.

halt_guidance.blocker: RamDA-seq public deposits are commonly plate/well organized and require explicit cell/well grouping, read-layout, and strandedness review before count generation.
required_inputs: Confirmed paired/single-end layout, strandedness, and RamDA-seq protocol variant
next_steps: Recover the plate/well map and establish whether each GSM/run represents a cell or a biological sample.
Confirm read pairing and strandedness from methods and representative FASTQs.
Prepare the explicit STAR-featureCounts target and verify expected cell/well columns and genomic coverage.

recommended_workflows.name: UniScFlow STAR-featureCounts target
recommended_workflows.role: Full-length RamDA-seq after explicit well-map and strandedness review

halt_guidance.resume: Rerun with an explicit RamDA-seq STAR-featureCounts target only after the plate map and read-layout assumptions are documented.
